own_solution.law: Parallel-plate capacitor at fixed voltage: F = Q E_other = eps0 A V^2 / (2 d^2), with eps0 A = C0 d0
assumptions: battery stays connected so V = 900 V at the final separation
vacuum between plates, no edge effects
eps0 A = 100 pF x 2 mm = 2e-13 F m

T75D2.regime: breakdown matters only if the field exceeds 1900 kV/m; the largest field (at 2 mm) is 900/0.002 = 450 kV/m

notes: Base: F = 2e-13 * 900^2 / (2 * (5e-3)^2) = 1.62e-7 / 5e-5 = 3.24e-3 N. With 1350 V: F = 2e-13 * 1.8225e6 / 5e-5 = 7.29e-3 N; the largest field is then 1350/0.002 = 675 kV/m, still below 1900 kV/m. Breakdown sentences both state 1900 kV/m; the 450 V sentences all state 450 V. Calling the neon sign's supply 'low-voltage' and then adding 450 V to it is a little artificial but has no path to the target.
